result.title: How AI Is Advancing Human Health
result.description:
In her special address at NVIDIA GTC Berlin, Kimberly Powell, Vice President of Healthcare and Life Sciences at NVIDIA, explored how digital health agents are reaching national scale, how AI factories are speeding up drug discovery from research to clinic, and how robotic systems are expanding access to surgical care and essential medicines. These advances point to an intelligent, connected healthcare ecosystem that can deliver faster innovation and wider access to care across Europe and the world.

result.title: Ten years. A Millionfold Leap in AI.
result.description:

result.title: How Audi is Reimagining Production With Digital Twins and Physical AI
result.description:
Audi teams are reimaginging production with digital twins and physical AI. See how production teams will build digital twins in DELMIA using LEO, a Dassault Systemes’ virtual companion and foundational knowledge from the 3DEXPERIENCE platform. With NVIDIA Omniverse libraries enabling perception and motion simulation, these digital twins become the virtual training ground for mobile humanoid robots from Agile Robots and Idealworks.

Scaling the simulation to multi-robot fleets ensures safe operation and will save months in future testing of logistics processes.
